source.title: New results and open problems in approximation of convex and star-like surfaces by algebraic level surfaces

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5568532 for document identifier 5568532. Local workflow shard metadata identifies the exact work as 'New results and open problems in approximation of convex and star-like surfaces by algebraic level surfaces', published in Jaen Journal on Approximation in 2009.

Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure plus metadata_only. Shell fetching could not resolve api.zbmath.org or web.ujaen.es, so the required internal download of a readable PDF artifact failed. Browser/search recovery found the exact Jaen Journal on Approximation table-of-contents page, Dialnet issue metadata, and a direct exact-work PDF candidate at https://web.ujaen.es/revista/jja/pdf/pre/jja-0001-01-09-7.pdf, but the PDF could not be opened or downloaded as a full readable source artifact in this environment.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the Jaen Journal table-of-contents page, Dialnet metadata, and the OpenAlex/local shard locator. Search-result snippets confirmed the title and candidate PDF identity, but snippets and resolver metadata are not acceptable technical sources for extraction under the source-adequacy gate.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The workflow forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, local shard rows, Dialnet issue metadata, table-of-contents pages, or search snippets.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-5568532.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
